sections.heading: Overview of Alumni Association
sections.content:
Mr. Pratik Sharma (Alumni), Treasurer, Alumni Association of APCOER 9604221994 pratiksharma512@gmail.com linkedin.com/in/yogeshdh99
I feel Very Proud to be a part of the institute. The institute aim is to ensure that its students achieve their highest academic and personal potential. It also aims to give them a firm foundation based upon understanding of Indian culture, society and ideas. Alumni Association of APCOER aims to provide scholarships to deserving students for the purpose of Education and Sport. The objective of association is to provide a platform to connect to Alumna and to assist recent graduates and current students in shaping their career in research field. As a treasurer of Alumni Association of APCOER I appeal to alumni contribute for research projects, development of lab and declare prizes, scholarships to merit students and financial aid to poor and deserving students of the institute.

### Overview of Alumni Association
Mr. Pratik Sharma (Alumni), Treasurer, Alumni Association of APCOER 9604221994 pratiksharma512@gmail.com linkedin.com/in/yogeshdh99
I feel Very Proud to be a part of the institute. The institute aim is to ensure that its students achieve their highest academic and personal potential. It also aims to give them a firm foundation based upon understanding of Indian culture, society and ideas. Alumni Association of APCOER aims to provide scholarships to deserving students for the purpose of Education and Sport. The objective of association is to provide a platform to connect to Alumna and to assist recent graduates and current students in shaping their career in research field. As a treasurer of Alumni Association of APCOER I appeal to alumni contribute for research projects, development of lab and declare prizes, scholarships to merit students and financial aid to poor and deserving students of the institute.
